statements.statement: The claims describe two different autonomous driving methods: an end-to-end CNN approach that learns the entire processing pipeline to steer a car (claim 1 from paper A) and an RNN-based ChauffeurNet that uses mid-level input and outputs driving trajectories (claim 2 from paper B).
While both methods are detailed, there is no claim providing a direct comparative evaluation of these two approaches under the same conditions or metrics.
This gap limits understanding of their relative strengths and weaknesses in autonomous driving tasks.

parsed.type_evidence: Claims 1 and 2 describe two different methods but do not provide any direct comparative evaluation, establishing a gap.
